relations.text: 主な製造委託先として実名で記載
relations.text_en: Named as a primary foundry supplier

source.label: Qualcomm 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: The primary foundry suppliers for our various digital, analog/mixed-signal, RF and PM integrated circuits include Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC)

relations.text: 主な製造委託先として実名で記載
relations.text_en: Named as a primary foundry supplier

source.label: Qualcomm 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Samsung Electronics and Global Foundries.

relations.text: 半導体の組み立て・テストの主な委託先として実名で記載
relations.text_en: Named as a primary assembly and test supplier

source.label: Qualcomm 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our primary semiconductor assembly and test suppliers are Advanced Semiconductor Engineering, Amkor Technology, Siliconware Precision Industries and STATSChipPAC.

relations.text: 半導体の組み立て・テストの主な委託先として実名で記載
relations.text_en: Named as a primary assembly and test supplier

source.label: Qualcomm 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our primary semiconductor assembly and test suppliers are Advanced Semiconductor Engineering, Amkor Technology, Siliconware Precision Industries and STATSChipPAC.

relations.text: 自社のカスタムコアとSoCは、アーキテクチャ ライセンス契約などで全面的にライセンスを受けていると記載
relations.text_en: Says its custom cores and SoCs are fully licensed under its Architecture License Agreement and related agreements

source.label: Qualcomm 10-Q(Q3 2026年度)
source.quote: are fully licensed under our existing Architecture License Agreement with Arm (the Qualcomm ALA) and Technology License Agreement with Arm (the Qualcomm TLA)
source.note: Armとは訴訟が続いています。
source.note_en: Subject of ongoing Arm v. Qualcomm litigation.

relations.text: ArmがQualcommおよびNuviaと、Nuvia Architecture License Agreementをめぐる訴訟中と記載
relations.text_en: Arm states it is in pending litigation with Qualcomm and Nuvia over the Nuvia Architecture License Agreement

source.label: Arm Holdings 20-F(2026年度)
source.quote: We are involved in pending litigation, including, but not limited to, lawsuits with Qualcomm Inc. and Qualcomm Technologies, Inc. (together “Qualcomm”) and Nuvia, Inc. (“Nuvia”).
source.note: ライセンス元とライセンス先の法的な争いです。Qualcommが陪審・最終判決で勝訴し、Armは控訴中と記載しています。
source.note_en: A legal dispute between licensor and licensee; Qualcomm prevailed at jury and final judgment, and Arm says an appeal is pending.

relations.text: 薄型モデム(MDM)製品をAppleへ販売。2025年度に売上の10%超を占める顧客
relations.text_en: Sells thin modem (MDM) products to Apple; Apple was a 10%+ revenue customer in fiscal 2025

source.label: Qualcomm 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Apple purchases our MDM (or thin modem) products, which do not include our integrated application processor technology, and which have lower revenue and margin contributions
source.note: Appleは自社製モデムを増やす見込みと記載しています。
source.note_en: Qualcomm expects Apple to increasingly use its own modems.

relations.text: 2025年度の連結売上の10%以上を占める顧客
relations.text_en: Revenues from Samsung comprised 10% or more of consolidated revenues in fiscal 2025

source.label: Qualcomm 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In fiscal 2025, revenues from Apple, Samsung and Xiaomi each comprised 10% or more of our consolidated revenues.

relations.text: Galaxy S26 Ultraは、Galaxy向けにカスタマイズしたSnapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5を搭載
relations.text_en: Galaxy S26 Ultra is powered by a customized Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 for Galaxy (Samsung newsroom)

source.label: Samsung Global ニュースルーム(Galaxy S26)
source.quote: powered by a customized mobile processor — Snapdragon® 8 Elite Gen 5 Mobile Platform for Galaxy
source.note: Galaxy S26 Ultraについての記載です。
source.note_en: Applies to the Galaxy S26 Ultra as described by Samsung.

relations.text: 主な製造委託先としてSamsung Electronicsを実名で記載(TSMC・GlobalFoundriesとあわせて)
relations.text_en: Named as a primary foundry supplier, alongside TSMC and GlobalFoundries

source.label: Qualcomm 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: The primary foundry suppliers for our various digital, analog/mixed-signal, RF and PM integrated circuits include Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC), Samsung Electronics and Global Foundries.

relations.text: 競合する半導体メーカーの1社としてSamsungを挙げている(戦略的パートナーでもある場合あり)
relations.text_en: Lists Samsung among competitors in integrated circuit products, some also strategic partners

source.label: Qualcomm 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Examples (some of which are strategic partners of ours in other areas) include Broadcom, HiSilicon, MediaTek, Mobileye, Nvidia, NXP Semiconductors, Qorvo, Samsung, Skyworks, Texas Instruments and UNISOC.

relations.text: 2025年度の連結売上の10%以上を占める顧客
relations.text_en: Revenues from Xiaomi comprised 10% or more of consolidated revenues in fiscal 2025

source.label: Qualcomm 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In fiscal 2025, revenues from Apple, Samsung and Xiaomi each comprised 10% or more of our consolidated revenues.
source.note: Xiaomiが自社でチップを開発していることにも言及しています。
source.note_en: Qualcomm notes Xiaomi develops its own integrated circuits.

relations.text: 4G・5Gの包括ライセンス契約を締結し、係争をすべて取り下げ
relations.text_en: Entered comprehensive 4G and 5G license agreements, dismissing all outstanding disputes

source.label: Qualcomm 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: entered into comprehensive 4G and 5G license agreements with Transsion (a growing, China-headquartered OEM that sells primarily in developing regions)
source.note: 特許ライセンス事業の関係です。

relations.text: Amazonのサーバー用チップ購入に連動する、最大2,500万株の新株予約権をAmazonに発行
relations.text_en: Issued Amazon a warrant for up to 25 million shares tied to Amazon purchases of Qualcomm server chip products

source.label: Qualcomm 8-K(2026年9月3日)
source.quote: related to the purchase of certain QTI server chip products, technology, systems and manufacturing services by Amazon, the Company issued a warrant
source.note: 拘束力のある発注があった分だけ権利確定します。
source.note_en: Warrant shares vest only with binding purchase orders.

relations.text: 最初のMicrosoft Copilot+ PCが、Snapdragon X Elite・X Plusを搭載
relations.text_en: The first Microsoft Copilot+ PCs launched with Snapdragon X Elite and X Plus processors

source.label: Microsoft ブログ(Copilot+ PCs)
source.quote: The first Copilot+ PCs will launch with both the Snapdragon® X Elite and Snapdragon® X Plus processors

relations.text: Intelが年次報告で、競合としてQualcommとAMDを挙げている
relations.text_en: Intel’s annual report names Qualcomm and AMD among its platform-product competitors

source.label: Intel 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our competitors include companies offering platform products, such as AMD and Qualcomm;

relations.text: NVIDIAが年次報告で、車載・ゲームなどのSoCの競合としてQualcommを挙げている
relations.text_en: NVIDIA’s annual report lists Qualcomm among SoC competitors for automotive, autonomous machines and gaming

source.label: NVIDIA 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: such as Ambarella, Inc., AMD, Broadcom, Intel, Qualcomm Incorporated, Renesas Electronics Corporation, and Samsung

relations.text: Qualcommが年次報告で、半導体の競合としてBroadcomを挙げている
relations.text_en: Qualcomm’s annual report lists Broadcom among competitors in integrated circuit products

source.label: Qualcomm 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Examples (some of which are strategic partners of ours in other areas) include Broadcom, HiSilicon, MediaTek, Mobileye, Nvidia, NXP Semiconductors, Qorvo, Samsung, Skyworks, Texas Instruments and UNISOC.

relations.text: Qualcommが年次報告で、半導体の競合としてMediaTekを挙げている
relations.text_en: Qualcomm’s annual report lists MediaTek among competitors in integrated circuit products

source.label: Qualcomm 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Examples (some of which are strategic partners of ours in other areas) include Broadcom, HiSilicon, MediaTek, Mobileye, Nvidia, NXP Semiconductors, Qorvo, Samsung, Skyworks, Texas Instruments and UNISOC.

relations.text: Qualcommが年次報告で、車載分野の競合としてMobileyeを挙げている
relations.text_en: Qualcomm’s annual report lists Mobileye among competitors (automotive)

source.label: Qualcomm 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Examples (some of which are strategic partners of ours in other areas) include Broadcom, HiSilicon, MediaTek, Mobileye, Nvidia, NXP Semiconductors, Qorvo, Samsung, Skyworks, Texas Instruments and UNISOC.

relations.text: Skyworksが年次報告で、競合としてQualcommを挙げている
relations.text_en: Skyworks’ annual report lists Qualcomm among its competitors

source.label: Skyworks 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our competitors include Analog Devices, Broadcom, Cirrus Logic, Murata Manufacturing, NXP Semiconductors, Qorvo, Qualcomm, and Texas Instruments.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
